name: DPIH
recent: DPIH 近期以 760 万令吉收购沙巴工业用地，并向两家子公司提供合计 850 万令吉的财务援助。公司同时公布季度业绩、派发第一次中期股息，并完成第九届常年股东大会。
notable: 子公司 Eastern Forever (Sabah) 以 760 万令吉收购沙巴 KKIP 工业用地。
公司向 Eastern Forever 和 Eastern Forever (Sabah) 分别提供 450 万和 400 万令吉的财务援助。
公司派发第一次中期股息，并公布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止季度的业绩。
risks: 收购土地需满足先决条件，包括取得开发商同意及解除现有抵押，完成期限可能延至 2027 年上半年。
收购价拟通过内部资金和/或银行贷款支付，若使用贷款，利率上升或信贷收紧将增加借贷成本。
土地为总地契下的单位，个别地契的发出与注册存在不确定性。

news.title: DPI Holdings to buy Sabah industrial land for RM7.6m

recent_en: DPIH recently acquired Sabah industrial land for RM7.6 million and provided RM8.5 million in financial assistance to two subsidiaries. The company also announced quarterly results, declared a first interim dividend, and completed its 9th AGM.
notable_en: Subsidiary Eastern Forever (Sabah) acquired industrial land in KKIP, Sabah for RM7.6 million.
The company provided RM4.5 million and RM4.0 million in financial assistance to Eastern Forever and Eastern Forever (Sabah) respectively.
The company declared a first interim dividend and announced quarterly results for the period ended 31 August 2026.
risks_en: The land acquisition is subject to conditions precedent, including obtaining developer consent and discharging the existing charge, with completion potentially delayed to 1H 2027.
The purchase price is intended to be funded via internal funds and/or bank borrowings; if borrowings are used, rising interest rates or tighter credit could increase borrowing costs.
The land is a unit under a master title, and the issuance and registration of individual titles carry uncertainty.
